name: What is the average cost range for new flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost range for new flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of new flooring installation varies widely based on the material chosen, the total area, and labor rates. Budget-friendly options like laminate or basic carpet might range from $3 to $7 per square foot. Mid-range options such as luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or engineered wood can cost $6 to $15 per square foot. Premium materials like natural stone tile or high-end hardwood can go upwards of $15 to $30+ per square foot. These figures typically include materials and professional installation. We provide a detailed, itemized quote after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flooring installation costs vary by material, area size, and labor, ranging from $3 to $30+ per square foot. We offer itemized quotes after consultation.
